about: src/lib/loyalty_card_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-loyalty card::card and card::stamps, the server card and the wallet pass stamp row). features/loyalty/public/card-vectors.test.tsx runs the join page card (loyalty_card) and the stamp row (stampable and its clamp, loyalty_stamps) against it. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
